mapper.insert: insert into employee(branch_code, dept, grade_code, position_code, name, phone, email, hire_date, status) values(#{branchCode},#{dept},#{gradeCode},#{positionCode},#{name},#{phone},#{email},#{hireDate},#{status})
mapper.select: select e.*, p.position_name, g.grade_name from employee e left join position p on e.position_code = p.position_code left join grade g on e.grade_code = g.grade_code where e.emp_no=#{value}
select count(emp_no) as totalEmp from employee
select count(branch_code) as totalBranch from employee group by branch_code
select count(emp_no) as newEmp from employee WHERE hire_date BETWEEN CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-01-01') AND CURDATE()

select e.*, p.position_name, g.grade_name from employee e left join position p on e.position_code = p.position_code left join grade g on e.grade_code = g.grade_code
and e.emp_no like CONCAT('%', #{empNo}, '%')
and e.dept like CONCAT('%', #{dept}, '%')
and p.position_name like CONCAT('%', #{positionName}, '%')
and g.grade_name like CONCAT('%', #{gradeName}, '%')
and e.name like CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET branch_code = #{branchCode}, dept = #{dept}, grade_code = #{gradeCode}, position_code = #{positionCode}, name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, hire_date = #{hireDate}, status = #{status} WHERE emp_no = #{empNo}
